title: identity-and-settings
objective: Story identity and settings homes: a chat plays its pinned copy through library edits and deletion, a new chat inherits the install profile, Restart is the only reset, and a chat saved by another version is refused until a confirmed Restart replaces it.

checks.goal: the example story carries an authored id, and the chat keys its state by it

steps.eval: const blob = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata.story_orchestrator; if (blob.version < 6) throw new Error(`expected a v6 blob, got ${blob.version}`); if (!blob.stories['sun-ruins']?.pinnedStory) throw new Error('story was not pinned into the chat'); if (blob.selectedStoryId !== 'sun-ruins') throw new Error(`selection not keyed by id: ${blob.selectedStoryId}`); return { keys: Object.keys(blob.stories), playedVersion: blob.stories['sun-ruins'].playedVersion };

checks.goal: the memory profile is stored install-wide, never in the chat

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const global = rt.getGlobalSettings(); if (!global.extraction.profileId) throw new Error('profile did not land in the install settings'); const extras = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata.story_orchestrator.stories['sun-ruins'].extras; if (extras.extraction?.settings) throw new Error('chat still carries extraction settings'); if (extras.memory?.settings) throw new Error('chat still carries memory settings'); return { profileId: global.extraction.profileId, chatExtractionKeys: Object.keys(extras.extraction ?? {}) };

checks.goal: deleting the library record leaves the running chat playable from its pinned copy

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ok = await rt.removeStory('sun-ruins'); if (!ok) throw new Error('remove failed'); await rt.loadSelectedFromChat(); const snapshot = rt.getSnapshot(); if (snapshot.activeCheckpointId !== 'cp2') throw new Error(`chat lost its story after library delete: ${snapshot.activeCheckpointId}`); return { identity: snapshot.storyIdentity, library: snapshot.library.length };

checks.goal: Restart is the only reset, and it re-pins the latest library version
a chat blob written by another build (v7) is read detached and never overwritten: import and a cancelled restart leave it byte-identical, and only a confirmed restart replaces it (v2.4 plan 02 §1)
